title: 第一卷 第25章 放心谁死了吴良都死不了第一卷 第26章 一人一蜥的小心思
content_zh:
几人被马长老骂得唯唯诺诺，不敢吭声。
五家试炼，历来受伤的都很多，可死人的情况却极少出现。
不是不懂。
而是不能。
落云宗家大业大，弟子众多，死上一些自然无关痛痒，可他们几家就那么点人，真要像马长老说的那样一照面就分生死……用不了一两次，五家就得从紫云城除名！
“马长老息怒。”
吴家家主硬着头皮道：“您说要结束，那就提前结束……”
“家……家主！”
“不……不好了！死……死了啊！”
刚说到这里。
一道惊慌失措，结结巴巴的声音陡然间从驻地外响了起来。
吴家家主一怔。
抬头看了一眼，发现一名留守吴家的族人正跌跌撞撞跑了过来。
“混账东西！”
他勃然大怒，破口骂道：“何事如此惊慌！什么死了！谁死了！”
“公……公子死了！”
“你说什么？”
吴家家主面色一白，如五雷轰顶！
“吴良……死了？”
“不，不是大公子，是二公子……二公子死了！”

吴家家主顿时松了口气。
吴良没死就……恩？
刚想到这里，他似突然意识到了什么，面色又是一僵，“你说，吴飞死了？”
“不止二公子！”
那族人捧出了一堆破碎的魂牌碎片，惶恐道：“全……全都死了啊……”
说话间。
他又是颤颤巍巍从怀里拿出了一枚完好的魂牌。
“就剩大公子了啊！”
轰的一声！
五雷再次落下，又是把吴家家主劈懵了！
都死了？
其余四人愣了一瞬，亦是大惊失色，只是失色之下，隐藏的却是喜色。
死了这么多精英。
等于断掉了吴家的一条臂膀，更能抵消吴良加入落尘宗带来的优势！
至于人是谁杀的……反正凭他们四家弟子的实力，肯定做不到，所以完全不重要！
“吴兄。”
刘家家主拍了拍吴家家主的肩膀，表情十分沉痛：“人死为大，节哀顺变……”
我顺你*！
content_en:
Several people were scolded by Elder Ma until they were submissive and did not dare to say a word.
There have always been many injuries in the five trials, but deaths rarely occur.
It’s not that I don’t understand.
But can't.
The Luoyun Sect has a great cause and many disciples, so it is not a big deal if some of them die, but there are only so many of them, and if they really want to be the difference between life and death as soon as they meet each other, as Elder Ma said... it won't take more than one or two times for the five families to be removed from Ziyun City!
"Elder Ma, calm down."
The head of the Wu family said bravely: "You said you want to end it, then end it early..."
"Family...owner!"
"No...it's not good! Die...die!"
Just said this.
A panicked and stammering voice suddenly sounded from outside the station.
The head of the Wu family was startled.
He looked up and saw that a clansman who had stayed behind in the Wu family was stumbling over.
"Bastard thing!"
He became furious and cursed: "Why are you so panicked! What's dead! Who's dead!"
"Young Master...Young Master is dead!"
"What did you say?"
The head of the Wu family turned pale, as if five thunders had struck his head!
"Wu Liang...is dead?"
"No, it's not the eldest young master, it's the second young master... The second young master is dead!"
The head of the Wu family breathed a sigh of relief.
If Wu Liang is not dead, then... eh?
Just when he thought of this, he seemed to suddenly realize something, and his expression froze again, "You said, Wu Fei is dead?"
"It's not just the second young master!"
The tribesman held out a pile of broken soul card fragments and said in panic: "They are all...all dead..."
While talking.
He tremblingly took out a intact soul card from his arms again.
"Only the eldest son is left!"
Boom!
The five thunders fell again, and the head of the Wu family was stunned again!
All dead?
The other four people were stunned for a moment, and they were also shocked, but underneath the loss of color, they were actually happy.
So many elites died.
It is equivalent to breaking an arm of the Wu family, and it can offset the advantages brought by Wu Liang joining the Luochen Sect!
As for who killed the person... anyway, with the strength of their four disciples, they definitely couldn't do it, so it doesn't matter at all!
"Brother Wu."
The head of the Liu family patted the head of the Wu family on the shoulder, with a very sad expression on his face: "Death is the most important thing, so we should mourn and accept changes..."
I'll follow you*!
